walledregions.MeasuredTemplateConfigurat: Settings specific to the Walled Region module
When disabled, this item uses native template or Region behavior and ignores Walled Regions settings.
Choose how the area interacts with walls. Damage modes block the area at standing walls and propose structural damage for GM approval.
Template ignores walls that do not block this type.
Connect this template so it moves along with the token.
When token rotates, rotate this template around the token.
When enabled, overrides settings to not target tokens with this template.
Overrides settings to always show or hide the border of this template.
Overrides settings to always show or hide highlighting for this template.
Overrides settings to always or never show the template when hovering over a token within the template.
